hero.title: Pioneering Gold & Diamond Mining Excellence
hero.subtitle: MC QUEST GOLD & DIAMOND MINING INDUSTRY LTD delivers world-class mining operations in Ghana's Eastern Region through LiDAR 3D drone technology and non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery.

about.title: MC QUEST GOLD & DIAMOND MINING INDUSTRY LTD
about.subtitle: A premier gold and diamond mining operation in Ghana's Eastern Region, combining cutting-edge LiDAR 3D drone technology with environmentally responsible surface mining.
about.historyDesc: MC QUEST GOLD & DIAMOND MINING INDUSTRY LTD was registered in 2025 in accordance with the Ghanaian Minerals and Mining Act. Our mining license covers approximately 405 hectares comprising 1,000 mining concessions in the Eastern Region, located 100 kilometers from Accra.
about.visionDesc: To be Ghana's leading technology-driven gold and diamond mining company, recognized for deploying LiDAR 3D drone technology and environmentally responsible mining methods.
about.missionDesc: To extract and process high-grade gold and diamond deposits using advanced mining drones with LiDAR 3D technology and non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery methods.
about.valuesDesc: Environmental responsibility, technological innovation, community partnership, transparency, and uncompromising safety standards.

timeline.foundingDesc: MC QUEST registered under the Ghanaian Minerals and Mining Act, securing mining licenses covering 405 hectares with 1,000 concessions. Ref No: CS007250125.
timeline.technologyDesc: Deployment of advanced mining drones equipped with LiDAR 3D technology for precise geological mapping and resource estimation.
timeline.operationsDesc: Launch of surface gold and diamond mining operations utilizing non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery methods.
timeline.resourceDesc: Completion of mineral resource estimate by Mining Plus using LiDAR 3D technology, diamond drilling (DDH), reverse circulation (RC), and rotary air drilling.
timeline.productionDesc: Achieved average grade of 10 g/t gold in high-grade deposit areas, establishing the operation as a significant producer.
timeline.expansionDesc: Development of additional processing capacity and exploration of new concession areas to scale production.

about.geologyDesc: The property is located at the Au-Ag epithermal belt in the Eastern Region. The mineralization is of the high-sulfidation epithermal type, hosted in volcanic rocks, alluvial and illuvial deposits.
about.resourcesDesc: Mineral resources estimated by Mining Plus using LiDAR 3D technology, diamond drill holes (DDH), reverse circulation (RC), supplemented by rotary air drilling.
about.cutOffDesc: A cut-off grade of 0.1 g/t Au was used with a low waste-to-ore ratio, estimated using a gold price of US$4,069.
about.recoveryRateDesc: An estimated recovery for gold of 90% is assumed with optimized operating costs.
about.teamDesc: Our operations are managed by experienced mining professionals with deep expertise in Ghanaian gold mining operations.
about.ctaDesc: MC QUEST GOLD & DIAMOND MINING INDUSTRY LTD is committed to becoming a leader in technology-driven, environmentally responsible mining in Africa.

operations.title: Mining Operations
operations.subtitle: Advanced surface mining operations in Ghana's Eastern Region, leveraging LiDAR 3D drone technology and non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery processes.
operations.openPitDesc: Our surface mining operations utilize advanced drones with LiDAR 3D technology for precise deposit mapping. Designed with a low waste-to-ore ratio.
operations.explorationDesc: Systematic exploration using diamond drill holes (DDH), reverse circulation (RC), and rotary air drilling across our 405-hectare concession area.
operations.processingDesc: On-site processing facilities employing modern crushing, grinding, and recovery technologies.
operations.recoveryDesc: Our proprietary non-mercury, cyanide-free gold recovery process produces pure gold, setting new environmental standards.
operations.goldRecoveryDesc: Advanced gold recovery using non-mercury, cyanide-free methods to produce pure gold.
operations.flowDesc: From LiDAR exploration to non-mercury gold recovery, our integrated process ensures maximum efficiency.
operations.flowExplorationDesc: Mining drones with LiDAR 3D technology for geological mapping
operations.flowMiningDesc: Extraction with low waste-to-ore ratio using advanced drone methods
operations.flowProcessingDesc: Crushing, grinding and modern recovery technology
operations.flowRecoveryDesc: Cyanide-free pure gold production with tailings management
operations.safetyDesc: Our operations fully comply with the Ghanaian Minerals and Mining Act and international safety and environmental standards.

operations.safetyItem2: Non-mercury, cyanide-free processing eliminating health hazards
operations.safetyItem3: LiDAR 3D drone technology reducing manual exposure in hazardous areas

sustainability.title: Sustainability & Environmental Responsibility
sustainability.subtitle: Our commitment to responsible mining extends beyond production — we use non-mercury, cyanide-free recovery and advanced LiDAR technology.
sustainability.environmentDesc: Non-mercury, cyanide-free gold recovery eliminates toxic chemical discharge. Tailing dams designed to international standards.
sustainability.communityDesc: Operating in Ghana's Eastern Region, we invest in local infrastructure, employment, and sustainable development programs.
sustainability.safetyDesc: LiDAR 3D drone technology reduces human exposure in hazardous mining areas. Our non-mercury process eliminates health risks.
sustainability.educationDesc: Skills development programs training local workforce in modern mining technologies, drone operation, and LiDAR data analysis.
sustainability.healthcareDesc: Community health programs and partnerships with regional healthcare providers.
